title: sales.order.void_line — payload
description: Voids a line of an open check that was already sent to the kitchen (sales#521). The reason is mandatory (market rule: Toast, TouchBistro, Lightspeed K-Series and LS Central ask for one to void a sent item). A line not sent yet is removed with sales.order.remove_line; a line already paid or voided, or on a closed check, is refused with sales.order_line_not_voidable.

reason.description: Why the plate comes off the check: kept on the line and carried in sales.order.line_voided for the kitchen.
